en: A monochrome illustrated postcard showing a Romanesque cathedral seen from under an arcade framing the view. The church has heavy stone walls, a tall square bell tower topped with an onion-shaped dome, and a large rose window on the façade facing an empty paved square. The style is detailed line drawing/etching printed on a cream card with a wide border. At the bottom of the image there is a handwritten artist signature on the left and a location caption on the right.
